fullPassage: The average person’s belief about themselves is, in general, flattering. A large majority of the public believe that they are more intelligent and fair-minded, better describers and less prejudiced than the average person. This is as true of the general public as it is of university students and their professors. This set of beliefs is known as the ‘Lake Wobegon’ effect, after a fictional community in the stories by Garrison Keillor, where all the children are above average. Again, a survey of high school seniors in the USA found that 70 percent thought they had above-average leadership qualities and only 2 percent believed they were below the average. And of university professors, 94 percent thought they were better at their jobs than their average colleague.

✅ ④ open-minded(열린 마음의): prejudiced는 '편견 있는'이라서 반대말은 '열린 마음의' open-minded예요. ← 정답

questions.passage:
(A) The students were asked to calculate the <u>average</u> score on the math test by adding all the scores and dividing by the number of students.

(B) The <u>average</u> person does not read more than five books a year, but dedicated readers consume dozens.
questions.stem: (A)와 (B)의 밑줄 친 average의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A)는 점수의 '평균값/수치', (B)는 'the average person'의 '평범한/보통의'. 같은 average의 다른 뜻.
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 평균값/수치 — (B) 평균값/수치: (B)는 '보통의 사람'이라 '수치'가 아니라 틀려요.

✅ ② (A) 평균값/수치 — (B) 평범한/보통의: (A)는 'calculate the average score'(평균 점수를 계산=수치), (B)는 'the average person'(평범한/보통 사람)으로 정확히 구분돼요. ← 정답

❌ ③ (A) 평범한/보통의 — (B) 평균값/수치: (A)·(B)가 서로 뒤바뀌어 틀려요.

❌ ④ (A) 평범한/보통의 — (B) 평범한/보통의: (A)는 계산된 '수치'라 틀려요.
det.tip: average = 평균값(수치) vs 평범한/보통의, 대표적인 다의어예요.

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"having an unfair opinion about someone or something that is not based on facts or reason"

det.korean: 정의 '누군가·무언가에 대해 불공정한 의견을 가진' = prejudiced(편견 있는).
det.analysis:
❌ ① fictional(허구의): 허구를 뜻해 정의와 무관해요.

❌ ② intelligent(똑똑한): 지능을 뜻해 정의와 달라요.

✅ ③ prejudiced(편견 있는): '불공정한 의견을 가진'이라는 정의와 정확히 일치해요. ← 정답

❌ ④ flattering(후한): 호의적임을 뜻해 정의와 달라요.
det.tip: unfair opinion about someone(불공정한 의견) → prejudiced

questions.passage: This set of beliefs is __________ (know) as the 'Lake Wobegon' effect, after a fictional community in the stories by Garrison Keillor, where all the children are above average.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

This set of beliefs is __________ (know) as the 'Lake Wobegon' effect, after a fictional community.

det.korean: know(원형) → known. 'is known as'(~로 알려져 있다) 수동태의 과거분사형.
det.analysis: 주어 'This set of beliefs'(이 믿음들)는 ~로 '알려지는' 대상이에요. be동사 is 뒤에서 수동태(be+과거분사)를 만들어야 하므로 know의 과거분사 known을 써서 'is known as'(~로 알려져 있다)가 돼요.
det.tip: 수동태 be + 과거분사 → is known as (~로 알려져 있다)

questions.passage: Again, a survey of high school seniors in the USA found that 70 percent thought they had above-average leadership qualities and only 2 percent __________ (believe) they were below the average.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

Only 2 percent of high school seniors __________ (believe) they were below the average.

det.korean: believe(원형) → believed. 앞의 thought와 짝을 이루는 과거 시제형.
det.analysis: 문장이 과거 사실을 전하고 앞 동사가 thought(과거)예요. 같은 흐름이므로 believe도 과거형 believed(믿었다)로 바꿔야 'only 2 percent believed'(2%만 믿었다)가 돼요.

questions.passage: The average person’s belief about themselves is, in general, flattering. A large majority of the public believe that they are more intelligent and fair-minded, better describers and less prejudiced than the average person. This is as true of the general public as it is of university students and their professors. This set of beliefs is known as the ‘Lake Wobegon’ effect, after a fictional community in the stories by Garrison Keillor, where all the children are above average. Again, a survey of high school seniors in the USA found that 70 percent thought they had __________ and only 2 percent believed they were below the average. And of university professors, 94 percent thought they were better at their jobs than their average colleague.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: above-average leadership qualities(평균 이상의 리더십 자질) — 70%의 고교생이 자신에게 있다고 생각한 것.
det.analysis:
❌ ① below the average(평균 이하): 70%의 긍정적 자기 평가와 반대라 틀려요.

❌ ② the general public(일반 대중): 빈칸 자리에 맞지 않아 틀려요.

✅ ③ above-average leadership qualities(평균 이상의 리더십 자질): 원문 'thought they had ___'(자신에게 ___가 있다고 생각)에 이어지는 표현이라 맞아요. ← 정답

❌ ④ fictional community(허구의 공동체): 다른 문장의 내용이라 틀려요.
det.tip: above-average leadership qualities = 평균 이상의 리더십 자질

Again, a survey of high school seniors in the USA found that 70 percent thought they had above-average leadership qualities and only 2 percent believed they were below the average. And of university professors, 94 percent thought they were __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: better at their jobs than their average colleague(평균적인 동료보다 일을 더 잘하는) — 교수 94%의 자기 평가.
det.analysis:
❌ ① less prejudiced than the average person(평균보다 편견이 덜한): 교수 평가가 아니라 일반인 믿음이라 틀려요.

✅ ② better at their jobs than their average colleague(평균적인 동료보다 일을 더 잘하는): 원문 '94 percent thought they were ___'(94%가 자신이 ___라고 생각)에 이어지는 표현이라 맞아요. ← 정답

❌ ③ more intelligent and fair-minded(더 똑똑하고 공정한): 교수 평가의 핵심 표현이 아니라 틀려요.

❌ ④ better describers than the general public(일반 대중보다 더 잘 묘사하는): 본문에 없는 내용이라 틀려요.
